label: fixture-short-release-no-flag
_why: A FIXTURE of the same-book gate (landmine L53, BALANCE_FRAMEWORK 10.118), read by preflight.ps1 Test-LmL53 through lib_same_book.ps1 Get-SameBookPlan. Never launched: _expect says what the gate must do with it, and for a pass _expect_kinds is the run_kind of each run in order. A release build is a book of ours in its player form, so it is gated like a config arm: a short run with no flag is refused.
